title: planPayload
responsibility: Validates a plan draft and preserves its optional proposed inputs, outputs and errors before local or hosted execution.

inputs.name: planPayload.input
inputs.description: Untrusted createPlan fields: category, title, goal and an optional proposed contract.

outputs.name: planPayload
outputs.description: Bounded plan fields, retaining the authored contract without adding states or viewports.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid categories, text, contract fields, oversized lists and duplicate error names.
